scope: All 15 studies developed in this v0.26.x conversation, including the completed short-horizon follow-up. Earlier unrelated MTFT papers are outside this handoff.
global_integration_notes: Preserve each frozen archive byte-for-byte. Fresh integrity checks validate bytes, not the underlying scientific hypotheses.
Keep each study in its own directory: names such as common.py, run_study.py, ising_exact.py and result files collide when flattened.
Replay in a writable copy because scripts overwrite adjacent results and plots; original manifests describe original bytes.
No executable Python/JavaScript source contains a hardcoded /workspace/, /mnt/ or /root/ path in the audited top-level scripts. Historical logs/JSON legitimately retain original run paths.
Study-specific pinned requirements are runtime records; package-level dependency policy and full release compatibility require separate validation.
SM_AUDIT-01 Higgs-defect wording is superseded. Archive the historical patch but block its application to 0.26.2/0.27.0.
A passing VALIDATION.json usually confirms replay/identity consistency. It does not mean every structural, approximation or physical hypothesis passed.

All physical interpretations retain declared inputs and limitations; no Standard Model identification, Clifford signature selection, Legendre proof or continuum critical exponent has been established.

Width and integer-size budgets need explicit production API policy; observed timings are not portable benchmarks.
